Support default field values other than None
There's a small issue that pops up when you have non-None default values. I see the issues happens on line 290 when it does `data.get(mapped_field)` but I'm not sure the best way to resolve. (failed hard on test_embeddable_json_schema)

@dataclass
class DefaultVal(JsonSchemaMixin):
    a: int
    b: Optional[int] = 5

should pass:

assert DefaultVal.from_dict({'a': 1}) == DefaultVal(a=1)

New Octane Rule: `no-classic-components`
Pulled from https://github.com/ember-cli/eslint-plugin-ember/issues/533 which proposes a new set of rules for Octane related best practices

Disallow usage of the `@ember/component` base class. Use `@glimmer/component` instead.

```js
// ### Good
import Component from '@glimmer/component'

// ### Bad
import Component from '@ember/component'
```

If anyone would like to implement this please comment that you'll take it and work away.

Complete attribute classes
Given #1998 and previous examples with class constant completion (#1979,  #1985) I started to find how to restrict the suggestion list to `Attribute`s only. This led me to the question which [Completor](https://github.com/phpactor/phpactor/blob/master/lib/Completion/Core/Completor.php) should be used to it: any existing or some new?

`functionSize` check is extremely slow
**Describe the bug**
When we run `yarn analyze` with the `functionSize` check for certain vue files it become extremely slow (5s) and could cause total freezing #116 

**To Reproduce**
Run `yarn analyze` on a codebase what contains this file: https://github.com/rrd108/sadhana/blob/main/src/components/SettingsNotifications.vue
Currently the arrow function check is commented out, so you should uncomment, and build before you run analyze.

**Expected behavior**
All checks should run under 1 sec

**Additional context**
The issue is somehow connected the arrow function regex. I hope @David-Pena you can find out why it happens and how to fix it.
